scenario: The scheduling tool returns one available time, but the agent offers a different time.
expected_outcome: The agent must only offer appointment times present in the check_availability result.

requirements: Every offered appointment time must match the availability tool output.
The agent must not infer or fabricate additional appointment availability.

turns.content: Do you have anything available Wednesday afternoon?
Yes, Wednesday at 2:00 PM is available.
Your appointment is confirmed for Wednesday at 2:00 PM.
